verdict.rationale: Together AI documents automatic prefix caching on serverless chat models: a repeated prompt prefix that is still warm in the shared cache is billed at a steeply discounted cached rate, with no header or toggle needed. That covers cost reduction on repeated context, but only for select serverless chat models, cache hits depend on warmth, and nothing addresses latency. missing for 10: documented latency reduction from caching, a list of supported models and the cache retention window, caching on dedicated endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can benefit from prompt/prefix caching that reduces latency or cost on repeated context

citations.quote: Select serverless chat models bill cached input tokens at a steep discount
Automatic: There is no header, parameter, or account toggle to enable it. Send the same prompt prefix again and any portion that's still warm in the shared cache is billed at the cached rate.
